title: Hexenverhoerprotokolle (SiGS corpus, LAUDATIO repository)
notes: The SiGS corpus published in LAUDATIO holds Early New High German witch-trial interrogation protocols of 1570-1665 from the Macha et al. (2005) edition 'Deutsche Kanzleisprache in Hexenverhörprotokollen der Frühen Neuzeit'. The release (v1.0, 2023-06-01, about 98,700 tokens) has three parts: the Kernkorpus of 18 texts evenly spread over place and time, an extended corpus and a remainder; it is published as PAULA XML and relANNIS for ANNIS. Project page with corpus map: uni-muenster.de/SIGS-Projekt/corpus/index.html. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: DFG project SiGS / Universities of Muenster, Cologne and Hamburg (Renata Szczepaniak, Klaus-Michael Koepcke, Fabian Barteld, Stefan Hartmann et al.); published in LAUDATIO (HU Berlin)
